snippet.title: Up and Down the Little Bridge 🌉🐻🐰 | Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs MariandJoy-11
snippet.description:
In the forest, Bunny Toto and Bear Coco found a little bridge. Step by step they walked slowly together and crossed it safely.

11. Up and Down the Little Bridge 🌉🐻🐰
Look! A little bridge!
Up and up the little bridge,
Step by step we go,
Feet go slow and eyes look straight,
Crossing nice and slow.

Up and down, up and down,
Little bridge so strong,
Walk together, one by one,
Moving right along!

Tap tap tap with tiny feet,
Hold your balance tight,
Across the bridge we safely go,
Everything’s all right!

Up and down, up and down,
Little bridge so strong,
Walk together, one by one,
Moving right along!

Slow slow, don’t rush now,
Keep your body straight,
Step by step we cross the bridge,
Walking nice and great!

Up and down, up and down,
Now we’re on the ground,
Good job crossing the little bridge,
Safe and happy sound!

snippet.title: Tick Tock Mouse Clock Song 🐭⏰🐹 | Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs MariandJoy-9
snippet.description:
A big clock went “tick-tock.”
A little mouse named Chichi climbed up to see it.
“Tick-tock, tick-tock,” the clock sang.
Then the bell rang, “ding, ding!”
Chichi was happy and sang with the clock.

9. Tick Tock Mouse Clock Song 🐭⏰🐹
Listen! The clock goes tick-tock!
A tiny mouse runs up so high,
Climbing near the clock up in the sky,
Tick goes tock, tock goes tick,
Time goes round so quick, so quick!

Tick-tock, tick-tock,
Hear the clock today,
Up up, down down,
Time goes on its way!

One goes ding, two goes ding,
Three goes ding — hear the ring!
The little mouse looks all around,
Listening to the happy sound.

Tick-tock, tick-tock,
Hear the clock today,
Up up, down down,
Time goes on its way!

Tick-tock, tick-tock,
Sing along with me,
Time and rhythm, fun to hear,
As happy as can be!

snippet.title: Itsy Bitsy Spider  ☔🕷️🌈 Tiny Spider Rainy Day Song | Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs MariandJoy-8
snippet.description:
On a rainy day, Joy found a small spider.
Joy encouraged the spider to climb the wall.
Singing along with Joy, you can learn words of encouragement for others.

8. Tiny Spider Rainy Day Song ☔🕷️🌈
Look! A tiny spider!
A tiny spider starts to climb,
Up the wall, nice and slow,
Step by step, up and up,
See how far it wants to go!

Climb climb, don’t give in,
Up you go again!
Climb climb, try once more,
You can reach the top!

Drip drop, here comes rain,
Washy splashy all around,
Down the spider slides a bit,
Landing softly on the ground.

Shake shake, don’t feel sad,
Dry your legs again!
Shake shake, try once more,
You can start again!

Peek-a-boo, the sun is out,
Warm and bright across the sky,
Up the spider climbs again,
Reaching high — give it a try!

Climb climb, up you go,
Brave and strong today!
Tiny spider, try again,
You did it — hooray!

snippet.description:

Jump and shout hooray!
